name: Unity-MCP
install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! dotnet --list-sdks 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^8\.'; then
  curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh
  sudo bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0 --install-dir /usr/share/dotnet
  sudo ln -sfn /usr/share/dotnet/dotnet /usr/local/bin/dotnet
fi
npm ci --prefix cli
npm run build --prefix cli
dotnet restore Unity-MCP-Plugin/Tests~/EngineFree/EngineFree.csproj
